summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the individual content sections that populate the generated README documentation. It ensures that specific parts of the project documentation, such as architecture, installation, and APIs, are correctly built and rendered.
responsibilities: Verify the correct generation of documentation sections
Validate the content structure for various README segments
Ensure consistent rendering of project information
relationships: The test suite validates individual documentation sections to ensure the final README content remains accurate.
Each test file corresponds to a specific structural component of the generated documentation.
designDecisions: Organized by documentation section to map directly to README content structure
Isolated testing for granular validation of individual documentation components
